title: Wildly Smoky Egyptian Dasima Kombu Skewers
description: A spicy and crispy Egyptian dish featuring dasima-kombu, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a smoky flavor and high protein content.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Egyptian spice mix, smoked paprika, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken and dasima kombu onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking and grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Check the chicken for doneness, it should reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges and chili flakes if desired.
